intro.text: A vine grown as a crop on Roshar, bearing clusters of hard pods that hold grain.

description.text: Yeddaw's farmers plant treb in slits about a foot wide in the stone. Crowded together, the vines grow dense and anchor themselves in the crack, and the pods wedge in tight so floods and highstorms can't carry them away.

Unlike lavis, tallew and clema, treb needs little tending. Because it survives floods, farmers can sow it in the Weeping, when other seeds are washed out before sprouting. Even so, farmers make more money from other crops.
